headline: Washburn hands Pittsburg State its first defeat
dek: Washburn have beaten Pittsburg State, the first defeat for a side that had gone the season unbeaten. Pittsburg State have conceded four goals in 21 matches, and still hold 15 wins against that single loss.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The drop from the top is steep rather than gradual: Washburn have more goals than Newman, Missouri Southern and Fort Hays State together.

wire.line: Washburn have scored 49 goals and conceded six, and are the only side to have beaten Pittsburg State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no result; Missouri Southern are in every one but Washburn's meeting with Baker.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Central Missouri have conceded seven goals in 20 matches while scoring 44.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Seventeen different players have scored for Pittsburg State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coryn Jespersen has 13 assists for Central Missouri, to go with four goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Juliette Langlet has made 121 saves for Northeastern State and conceded 18 goals.

last_match.line: Pittsburg State had lost nothing all season; Washburn's only defeat had come against them.

next_match.line: Nebraska Kearney come to the spring having won once in conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
